content.text:
**Finding: missing — no insurance covenant anywhere in the Agreement.**

- Searches for "insurance", "coverage" and "workers compensation" returned nothing; a full read of the definitions (§1), the indemnity/limitation provisions (§12) and all miscellaneous sections (§§13–30) plus Exhibits A and B confirmed no insurance obligation exists.
- TrueLink hosts the Web Site and transmits/processes Client Content and Credit Data (borrower and loan-applicant data), so the total absence of insurance is walk-away territory, not a fallback-level shortfall.
- Cure: one `insert_after` op adding a new Section 31 (INSURANCE) after Force Majeure, carrying exactly the six preferred elements — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M triggered by processing of any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Client (deliberately broader than the named data definitions), statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. No survival tail, expense language or other boilerplate added; the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is offered in the comment.
